messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Cygnus VPC - sudden spike in 429s across their prod cluster (cygnus-prod) · triggered by rate_counter > threshold · paging oncall
laura: oncall here, ack'ing. jumping in. paging runtime + SRE · @maria @devon
devon: looking at graphs now — 429 rate went from ~0.5% to 14% in the last 3m. errors concentrated on worker set 'cygnus-prod-w-3' and token service calls. link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/cygnus/429s
maria: thanks. adding context: customer is on VPC w/ dedicated pool, but traffic is hitting shared routing tier before pool assignment. suspect a noisy tenant job causing request amplification.
laura: visible client impact: customer reports timeouts in their frontend, BIZ team pinged AM. severity: customer-facing, realtime features degraded.
devon: quick check of logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z  INFO request id=abc123 tenant=cygnus-job worker=cygnus-prod-w-3 status=200 latency=120ms
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z  WARN request id=abc124 tenant=cygnus-batch worker=cygnus-prod-w-3 status=429 reason="rate_exceeded"
2026-03-15T10:12:08Z  WARN request id=abc125 tenant=cygnus-batch worker=cygnus-prod-w-3 status=429 reason="rate_exceeded"
```
Looks like an internal tenant named `cygnus-batch` is hammering the pool.
laura: two parallel actions: (1) immediate mitigation to reduce customer-visible 429s, (2) triage noisy tenant source.
maria: mitigation options: route Cygnus traffic to standby dedicated pool `dedicated-cygnus-fallback-2` (fast), or apply tenant-isolate to throttle `cygnus-batch` at the router (safer). routing switch will require an infra config flip; runbook below.
laura: runbook step 1: route flip. I'm OK to do that now if SRE can monitor. devon?
devon: proceed with route flip. I'll run the change and watch. publishing change via admin API:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routes/switch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"customer":"cygnus","from":"shared-routing","to":"dedicated-cygnus-fallback-2","reason":"emergency 429 relief"}'
```
I've got monitoring open.
alex: note — fallback pool has lower concurrency per-worker; it will reduce amplification but may affect throughput. Have a quick quantized model ready if we need to reduce token load.
ben: finance/AM here — customer is on enterprise contract. we can approve a temporary quota bump or override if routing flip doesn't fully restore service. need explicit start/end times for billing note.
laura: let's flip routes first and defer contract override unless we still see >5% 429s after flip. Set override window to now -> 08:00 UTC if needed. ben, please standby to sign off.
devon: applying route change now. patch request sent.
(sre-runbook-bot): change-request 2754321987: route flip initiated by devon. checklist: pre-checks done, backup route saved.
devon: change completed. controlplane response: 200 OK. routing table now points cygnus -> dedicated-cygnus-fallback-2
laura: monitoring — post-flip 429 rate down to 2.1% after 45s. latency improved. :white_check_mark:
maria: great. still see some retries from `cygnus-batch` causing occasional spikes. will run tenant-isolate in parallel to prevent re-triggering.
alex: running tenant-isolate: `tenantctl isolate --tenant cygnus-batch --limit 10rps --reason "emergency noisy job"`
(sre-runbook-bot): tenant-isolate job 834 queued by alex.
alex: isolate applied, logs show `rate_limit set for cygnus-batch = 10rps`.
devon: confirmed overall 429s now stable <1% for the last 3m. sending note to customer ops with status.
ben: approved contingency override if we need it. fwds to billing for record: override window 2026-03-15T10:12 -> 2026-03-15T08:00 UTC (end of day local agreement) — noted.
laura: next steps: 1) keep fallback routing active until 08:00 UTC; 2) runtime team to investigate why `cygnus-batch` bypassed tenant-level throttles; 3) create customer-facing incident summary and follow up with AM.
maria: I'll open a ticket for root cause and follow-up runbook item: pre-warm fallback pools when job patterns spike, and strengthen early detection on shared-routing.
laura: thanks team. I'll mark incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. will close when stable for 1h. cc @ben for customer comms. :v:
